summary: Synchronously test F_OK/R_OK/W_OK/X_OK access using Node's process and OS permission semantics.
caveats: Checking access before opening a file introduces a race; preserve source behavior but do not optimize into assumptions.
.NET ACL helpers do not directly model effective POSIX access checks across platforms.

tests.name: F_OK succeeds
tests.expected_behavior: returns undefined when the entry is visible to the process

tests.name: missing throws
tests.expected_behavior: throws a Node-compatible filesystem error when the check fails
